bill.title: Earl N. Williams, Sr., First Chance Act

aiDescription.summary: This bill adds basic and emergency living-assistance grants to the Student Support Services program to help undergraduate participants cover anticipated or unexpected living and related costs. Recipients may use up to 2% of SSS funds; emergency grants are capped at $500 for 2027–28 and thereafter indexed to CPI increases.

impact.summary: The bill amends the Higher Education Act to require institutions with Student Support Services (SSS/TRIO) grants to provide basic and emergency supplemental living assistance to current SSS participants. It permits 2% of SSS funds for these grants and caps emergency awards at $500 for 2027–28.
